_source: Every biographical line below is taken from Tausif's own live profile README (tausif-ahmed-guardian/tausif-ahmed-guardian, commits of 11 Nov 2026 authored by him). Add nothing here that he has not stated himself.
name: Tausif Ahmed
title: Founder and CEO, Purplecop Security
tagline: Cybersecurity, GRC, AI security and post-quantum readiness practitioner.
question: Which control proves this is safe, and what evidence shows it works?
about: I've spent more than a decade on the side of security that has to stand up in front of an auditor: controls, evidence, risk, and the frameworks that tie them together. Now I build products and companies in that space, and I give back to the open standards and tools the field runs on.

focus.title: Governance, risk and compliance
focus.text: ISO 27001, SOC 2, CMMI, GDPR, India's DPDP Act, SOX 404 and ITGC. One control mapped to many requirements, evidence automation, third-party risk.

focus.title: AI security and governance
focus.text: ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF and the EU AI Act. Prompt injection, data leakage and over-privileged tools, and the evidence that proves an AI control works.

focus.title: Post-quantum readiness
focus.text: FIPS 203, 204 and 205. Crypto inventory first (CBOM), then migration run as a governance problem: owners, timelines, vendor dependencies, evidence.

focus.title: Cybersecurity
focus.text: Turning advisories (CISA KEV, vendor PSIRTs) into actions a team can take this week. Security programmes that pass an audit without becoming paperwork.

experience: Earlier: compliance roles at JLL (for Google India) and American Express, covering SOX, ITGC, vendor risk and EMEA audit.
